ideas.pitch: A localized web application that allows institutions to conduct quizzes and exams in a fully offline campus environment without internet connectivity.
ideas.title: AcharyaCampus Offline Quiz & Assessment Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a logistical pain point frequently experienced by college faculty and judges in campus settings, following the proven runner-up pattern of building robust offline-first educational tools.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based visual novel and simulation game educating students on water management systems within the Acharya Institute campus.
ideas.title: Campus Water Conservation VR/Interactive Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamified education with institutional sustainability, following the prize-winning pattern of engaging educational narratives used in prior hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice assistant loaded with Acharya Institute handbook data and event schedules, using RAG to provide instant spoken answers to student queries.
ideas.title: Voice-Enabled Student Inquiry RAG Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical local RAG implementation with a fully working live voice demo, matching the most accurate winning project archetype.

ideas.pitch: A fullstack booking and tour guide management portal for campus facilities, labs, and sports complexes tailored for visitors and prospective students.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Tour & Booking System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents a clean, production-ready fullstack solution that university administrators can immediately deploy, leaning on the success of past booking platform winners.

ideas.pitch: A digital portal that assists students in navigating institutional financial aid and loan applications through automated document verification and conversational guidance.
ideas.title: AI-Powered Student Loan & Scholarship Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a complex bureaucratic workflow with an intuitive digital-branch experience, directly mirroring the strategy of standard-setting financial hackathon champions.
